name: filter-bar
summary: Arranges host-admitted filter controls, actions, applied-filter content, and an optional result summary.

agent.useWhen: An app-owned search or result page needs a labelled presentation group around already-admitted controls and actions.
agent.avoidWhen: The component must own a GET form, query parameters, search state, command, route, applied-filter semantics, or JavaScript behavior.

invariants: The output is a div role=group, never a form; the host owns form/query binding and all operations.
Controls are required host-admitted markup; actions and applied content are optional host-admitted markup.
The optional result summary is nonblank escaped text announced with role=status.
AdmittedChildren is a host trust marker, not an HTML sanitizer.
The fragment contains exactly one [[attributes]], [[label]], [[summary]], [[controls]], [[actions]], and [[applied]] slot; expansion is exact and single-pass.

attributes.name: summary
rules: A literal or one whole checked string field; emitted as escaped status text.
Direct children are named slots; whitespace is permitted only outside slots.
Do not wrap slots in an outer loop or conditional.
This is a presentation group, not a form; the app owns the GET/command wrapper, query binding, and operations.

attributes.name: name
rules: Allowed names are controls (required), actions (optional), and applied (optional); each may occur at most once.
Controls, actions, and applied content are host-admitted markup; supported nested components, links, and template flow may be used.
The controls slot must contain nonblank content.
The controls slot is required; actions and applied slots are optional.
Admitted child content is subject to host validation and is not sanitized by this component.
The app owns form semantics, routes, query parameters, and commands.

examples.name: customer-filters
examples.summary: A filter presentation group with a native select control and a separate navigation action.
examples.template: View all customers
requirements: App provides result_summary as a string field; register customers_index route if using the navigation link.
The app owns the surrounding GET form or command wrapper and the selected query value.
Host admits the nested select-field and option declarations.
